newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH ENTERPRISING BOOM SEEN IN 1997 - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH ENTERPRISING BOOM SEEN IN 1997 - PAPER.

text.p: There will be a boom in small private enterprises next year, daily Kauppalehti reported on Wednesday.

It quoted managing director Erkko Moisander at the government's regional development credit agency Kera as saying that it had seen strong demand in credits under 100,000 markka which was a sign that the service sector is recovering.
"Small companies in various sectors seem to be finding their markets," the paper quoted Moisander a saying.
"I believe that the amount of credits will rise to hundreds of millions to new and old small and medium size firms in the medium term," he was quoted.
